title: Enquirer’s Guide: What does Newton have to do with it?
summary: Newton’s work on light and color supplied the methods and questions that later investigators used.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “What does Newton have to do with it?”
Newton’s work on light and color supplied the methods and questions that later investigators used.
In our historical account, he noticed an unexplained detail in certain shadows but did not claim to have found the Stratum. The science that bears its name arose after his time.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
